host: DGX Spark GB10, aarch64; other tenants' containers resident

worker_queue_wake.what: time from submitting a task to the worker claiming it; 12 submissions at random moments against the worker's 5 s poll; the measurement script imports the test corpus and runs both loops in one process

memory_models_footprint.what: MemAvailable with both memory services running and used, after stopping both, and after starting and using them again (deploy/memory/run.sh)
memory_models_footprint.note: On unified memory a container's CUDA allocations and its process memory both come out of MemAvailable; other workloads on the host moved by a few hundred MiB during the measurement.

reranker_prompt_template.what: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B served by vLLM, recall@1 over all 48 statements per query, with and without the model's own prompt template

ranking_rules_compared.what: recall@1 on the 108 answerable queries, computed offline from one set of scores
ranking_rules_compared.reading: fusing the lexical order into the semantic one lowers recall; the lexical hits are kept only as extra candidates for the reranker

reranker_as_answer_judge.what: strict instruction (does the statement state the answer), the four facts of each near/para query's subject
reranker_as_answer_judge.reading: not usable for the memory-answer decision; the answer model is (accel_after_memory_answer_check.json)
